detector.name: LangChain - Token usage detector
detector.programText:
A = data('gen_ai.usage.input_tokens', filter=filter('gen_ai.system', 'langchain')).publish(label='A')
B = data('gen_ai.usage.output_tokens', filter=filter('gen_ai.system', 'langchain')).publish(label='B')
detect(when(A > threshold(20000))).publish('LangChain - Token usage detector')

rules.description: The value of Input tokens is above 20000.
